snippet.title: SYS//PURGE_ Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
SYS//PURGE_ is a free, fast-paced FPS inspired by 90's classics, with roguelike elements. Collect items, stay alive and descend deeper into the facility. You take control of an LN-X unit, a glitch breaks you out of the Overseer's control. Make it burn. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4296670/SYSPURGE/

Trailer by @natumescudi and KaKeL
